Hi Jonas,

Quick question on how Redwood issues invoices — our AP team needs to confirm whether you can:

- Include our PO number on the invoice PDF AND in the email subject line,
- Deliver invoices via email to accounts-payable@cobalt-industries.com (we have procurement policies that prevent portal enrollment for some vendors),
- Include our VAT ID and a clear tax treatment line (we need to see a reverse-charge note where applicable).

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: we can do emailed PDF delivery with PO-in-subject for an initial probation period, and we can show VAT treatment on the invoice PDF. Portal enrollment is our recommended long-term flow but not mandatory.

Details / proposed approach:
- First three invoices: we will send emailed PDFs to accounts-payable@cobalt-industries.com and finance@cobalt-industries.com (please confirm the finance alias if different). The email subject will include your PO (e.g., PO 23098).
- Invoice fields: our attached Redwood_Invoice_Template_v1.pdf includes a dedicated VAT ID field and a tax-treatment line where we will put "Reverse charge (Article 194)" when you supply an EU VAT ID.
- Portal benefit: tipping to portal provides machine-readable invoice JSON/UBL and automatic PO matching, but we understand procurement constraints. If you later opt in, Kimberly can run a quick onboarding with your AP team.
- Payment terms / collection: default is 30 days NET via ACH or wire. If your treasury requires a different flow, let us know.

Action items for Cobalt:
1) Confirm accounts-payable and finance email addresses to receive PDFs.
2) Confirm whether PO will always be present and provide a sample PO format (we'll mirror the field).
3) Share EU VAT ID if reverse-charge should be applied.

I've attached our sample invoice template and the signed MSA for reference. CCing Kimberly (portal/onboarding) and Ben (billing ops) to keep the handoff tight.

Best,
Jonas Weber

Hi Sophie — thanks for the context. A couple of quick notes from the onboarding side: 

- Portal onboarding: if at any point your AP can accept supplier portal invites, we can create an onboarding token that pre-populates your VAT ID and PO mapping — that reduces manual validation and speeds reconciliation. Typical onboarding takes 3 business days once AP returns the supplier form.
- Supplier form: I can send a short DocuSign supplier profile (company name, remit-to, VAT ID, preferred currency, payment terms). That form isn't a gate — it's just to reduce back-and-forth.
- Temporary exception: we are happy to do the one-off email-delivery with PO-in-subject for the initial invoices. Ben here will ensure the PDF includes a VAT line and a machine-readable invoice number.

If you prefer I can send the DocuSign supplier profile now and mark your account as "email-only" until procurement policy allows portal enrollment.

Kimberly Park
